semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Tohoku Steel provides specialized metal materials and processing services that can be relevant for semiconductor manufacturing, particularly in areas requiring advanced materials and bonding techniques.
summary: Tohoku Steel is an engineering manufacturer specializing in the development and processing of special steel materials. They offer a range of services including vacuum melting, forging, and diffusion bonding, which are essential for creating high-performance components used in semiconductor applications.
capabilities: Diffusion bonding of dissimilar metals and non-ferrous materials
Precision bonding with minimal displacement and deformation
